result:
I have everything needed. The fix: the type-only import uses a stale relative path (`../../../utils/powershell/parser.js`, which no longer exists after `parser.ts` moved to the `@thyrox/shell` package); `powershellSecurity.ts` itself already imports the same types from `@thyrox/shell/powershell/parser.js`. Since it's `import type`, changing the path doesn't affect runtime.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/tool-registry/src/tools/PowerShellTool/__tests__/powershellSecurity.test.ts",
 "edits": [{"old": "import type { ParsedCommandElement, ParsedPowerShellCommand } from \"../../../utils/powershell/parser.js\";",
            "new": "import type { ParsedCommandElement, ParsedPowerShellCommand } from \"@thyrox/shell/powershell/parser.js\";"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "type-only-import-stale-relative-path-to-migrated-package",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS2307.*Cannot find module '\\.\\./.*utils/powershell/(parser|dangerousCmdlets)\\.js'",
               "fix_generico": "Cuando un import type usa una ruta relativa a `utils/powershell/...` que ya no existe porque el módulo se movió al paquete `@thyrox/shell`, se reemplaza por la ruta del paquete (`@thyrox/shell/powershell/<módulo>.js`), la misma que usa el productor real del tipo (p. ej. powershellSecurity.ts). Al ser `import type`, se borra en tiempo de ejecución y no cambia la conducta.",
               "edits": [0]}],
 "fixes": ["src/packages/tool-registry/src/tools/PowerShellTool/__tests__/powershellSecurity.test.ts(2,68): error TS2307: Cannot find module '../../../utils/powershell/parser.js' or its corresponding type declarations."],
 "skipped": []}
```
